name: flat-p3-b
description: Seed replicate of flat-p3 (seed 23; identical otherwise). The run-to-run spread of 50-90 is the known hazard for a one-run-per-arm comparison, so the ply-3 against ply-2 field verdict uses two runs per arm (the analyst's plan theory-2 6.15 for flat-p3-b; the coordinator added flat-p2-b for balance). Does a field playing at ply 3 train a better ply-3 evaluator than one playing at ply 2? 4 F-L lines (default settings) in a pure field with self-games and no references, 15 rounds a cycle, scaled plateau with min_cycles 200, standard T 0.1 tournament on chessai-hybrid10 (byte-identical to hybrid9; ply-3 search about 21% cheaper for LR). The twins flat-p3 and flat-p2 differ only in the field's ply, so the ply of the training games is the one factor. Verdict: a T 0.02 arena of every line's final version at ply 2 and 3, with lr-settings-new's F-L lines and F-L-d4mix-c v426 alongside. The analyst's first-priority plan (theory-2 6.11; the twin added by the coordinator for one factor), launched 11-11 ~01:40 under the user's standing instruction to launch without them.
